dataset_description: Deterministic retrieval-only evaluation for durable operational memory. Synthetic facts are designed to expose multilingual, paraphrase, code, temporal, contradiction, multi-evidence and tenant-interference behavior.

informational: Abstention accuracy is reported but not gated until a confidence policy is specified.
This v1 corpus is synthetic and must not be presented as a competitor benchmark.
Aura quality uses read-only recall_as_of to prevent query-order activation from changing ranking.
